caption: The video captures a close, low-angle view of the rear and right side of a yellow double-decker city bus, badged MAN with fleet number 2965. On the tinted rear window, the slogan MOBILIDADE FLEXÍVEL sits above a white line-drawing of a suspension bridge, beside a column of three blue accessibility icons. A round red tail light and a small red side marker stay lit throughout. Weathered pale facades line the left, while an iron-balconied building, a church tower and a crane fill the right under clear blue sky. The bus drifts gradually rightward within the frame, its MAN logo, icon column and tail-light cluster translating together while size, shape and orientation stay constant. The nearer left building shifts slightly the opposite way and the far background stays fixed. The bridge drawing, text and icons remain legible and unchanged, merely carried along by this slow drift, already underway at the first frame and continuing at the last.
